heading.title: Rules in cases of Intestates other than Parsis

article.title: Where intestate has left only great-grandchildren or remoter lineal descendants.
article.content:
39Where intestate has left only great-grandchildren or remoter lineal descendants.

Section 39  ·  Part V · Chapter II  ·  page 23 of the Act
In like manner the property shall go to the surviving lineal descendants who are nearest in degree to the intestate, where they are all in the degree of great-grandchildren to him, or are all in a more remote degree.
